spec_match.rationale: Implements the §10.4→§10.5 transfer function exactly (toe c/12.92 below 0.04045, else the 2.4 curve), reproduces the spec's worked pair 0.591/0.123/0.264 ↔ 0.3081/0.014/0.0567, and the browser cross-check uses relative color syntax against display-p3 — the conversion the spec defines.

interactive.rationale: Sliders rebuild the per-channel decode table, both color() strings, and both swatches live; the verify button performs a real getComputedStyle round-trip; CDP confirmed the green slider rewrote row 2 (0.8 → 0.6038, re-encode ✓) and the toe preset switched the rule column.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises channel-by-channel decoding plus an in-browser proof of equivalence; the page delivers both, with the proof honestly gated on support.

edge_cases.rationale: The toe/curve branch boundary is a first-class preset, the re-encode column cross-checks the math on every render, and the unsupported verify branch reports itself instead of pretending.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, §10.5, and the spec's sample conversion code are all linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's linear-to-gamma-conversion assertion pins this page's exact claim (the spec pair, within 0.005) and fails cleanly rather than erroring where the space is missing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP on Chromium 141: decode table, strings, presets, and the honest unsupported verify branch all exercised with zero console errors; the display-p3 swatch is real (computed color(display-p3 0.591 0.123 0.264)). NOT verified: the relative-color match verdict itself, which needs Chrome 144+.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts p3-linear-relative-color-roundtrip on the supported path and p3-linear-verify-unsupported-branch explicitly when the space is absent.

design_system.rationale: Variables only, AA pairs (emerald/rose verdicts on stone), table with stone headers, buttons keep the global colour pair.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native sliders, caption + th scope on the decode table, aria-live outputs for strings and verdict, swatches as role=img with per-state names including the explicit nothing-painted unsupported name.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow (table sits in its own scroller), 44px targets, slider grid shrinks via minmax(0,1fr).

openQuestions.title: Run the relative-color verification on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: The match/mismatch verdict — converting color(display-p3-linear 0.3081 0.014 0.0567) back to display-p3 in-browser and comparing against the sliders within 0.005 — has only been executed down its unsupported branch on Chromium 141. A 144+ pass should confirm the match verdict, the telemetry assert, and that both swatches render identically.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table live recalculation semantic markup
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic tables with caption and th scope for data; announce recalculated results through live regions, not visuals alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The decode table carries a caption and th scope=col/row; the color() strings and the verify verdict are aria-live polite outputs.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP read the rebuilt row text after a slider change: 'green 0.8 curve … 0.6038 0.8 ✓'.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Flexible grid tracks with minmax(0,1fr); wide content gets its own scroll container rather than widening the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Slider rows use minmax(5rem,8.5rem) minmax(0,1fr) 4rem; the five-column decode table is wrapped in .scroller with overflow-x:auto.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP overflow check: scrollWidth == clientWidth at both 360 and 1280.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection exact CSS.supports probe fallback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Probe the exact declaration being demonstrated and branch honestly on the result.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both CSS.supports('color','color(display-p3-linear 0 1 0)') and the shipped display-p3 probe gate their own swatches independently, so the page degrades per-surface instead of all-or-nothing.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: On 141 the display-p3 swatch is browser-painted while the linear swatch is hatched and labelled dropped.

summary: Inspection-tool concept: the whole feature is one transfer function, so the page decodes it channel by channel with the branch boundary as a preset, shows the re-encode check, and asks the browser to prove the equivalence via relative color syntax where it can. On Chromium 141 the math, table, presets, and honest unsupported verdict were all CDP-verified with a real native display-p3 swatch alongside.
